verification.note: Stored and read in this run: Global Affairs Canada's page with the full English text and its PDF version (international.gc.ca, official), which confirm the title and the twelve commitments by 'the Leaders of the G7' but are undated; and the Government of Canada Publications catalogue record FR5-144/2018-27E-PDF (publications.gc.ca, official), which confirms the issue on 9 June 2018 as one of eight declarations of the Charlevoix summit (44th G7 summit, La Malbaie), Global Affairs Canada as publisher and the French edition's title; it is proposed as secondary_url so that the dated source stays in the record's local copy. The candidate's earlier publications.gc.ca PDF link leads to an archived-content notice with no text.

changes.secondary_url: the Government of Canada Publications catalogue record, the official source for the date of issue, the summit and the French edition; the record had no secondary URL, so after a merge its local copy would have no dated source
changes.verification.note: rewritten for the sources stored in this run

judgment.status_reasoning: A leaders' declaration of commitments without binding force. Nothing stored withdraws or replaces it; later G7 AI texts (G7-01 to G7-06) do not refer to it as superseded. 'Published (non-binding, current)' stands.
judgment.summary_check: The summary matches the twelve commitments on the stored page and PDF.
judgment.notes_check: The references to the 2018 Montreal ministerial statement and the 2017 Torino Declaration and the list of other commitments match the stored text; the eight declarations, La Malbaie and the French title match the catalogue record.
